content_blocks.label: clause_1._TERM_AND_PREMISES
content_blocks.text: This Lease Agreement shall commence on June 20, 2024, and shall terminate on June 19, 2027, hereinafter referred to as the `Term`. The Premises are located at 123 Maple Street, Springfield, State of Novaria.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_RENT
content_blocks.text: The Tenant shall pay Rent in the amount of $1,200.00 per month, payable on the first day of each calendar month.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._USE_OF_PREMISES
content_blocks.text: The Tenant shall use the Premises solely for residential purposes and shall not sublet, assign, or otherwise transfer possession without the prior written consent of the Landlord.
